messages:
Romi H.: Quick sync: proposing a jitter + backoff on RR fallback to reduce claim collisions when enrichment times out. Planning a 20% canary later today.
Asha P.: Love that. what's the jitter/backoff plan? want something simple to reason about for docs.
Connor W.: Plan: base fallback happens after 30s. RR webhook will include a random jitter 0-4s. If queue claim fails, apply exponential backoff up to 30s total with steps [2s, 4s, 8s, 16s]. This prevents thundering.
Ben S.: Also add a short TTL on the fallback tag so if enrichment finishes soon after fallback we can reassign owner via smart-assign and mark reassign=true.
Romi H.: Good point. We'll set property(fallback_ttl_seconds)=300 and property(reassign_allowed)=true for canary leads.
Asha P.: HubSpot workflow snippet for the playbook (docs):
```
Trigger: Contact created
Delay: 30s
If: property(enriched)==true -> Smart assign owner
Else -> POST to RR webhook with payload: {queue: "Overflow RR", experiment: "rr_jitter_backoff", jitter_max: 4}
```
Connor W.: RR webhook behavior (for devex notes): on receive -> wait random(0, jitter_max) seconds -> attempt assign -> if assign_fail then retry with backoff steps. set property(fallback_reason)=ENRICH_TIMEOUT on first assign, set property(fallback_attempts) increment on retries.
Ben S.: Observability: add metrics fallback_attempts_total and fallback_reassigns_total. Alert if fallback_reassigns_total/fallbacks_total > 0.05 for 15m (means enrichment catching up after fallback).
SDR Lead: SDRs will pause outbound drips for experiment leads and monitor any manual claim requests. We'll opt-in to the soft-pickup notifications.
HubSpot Bot: Workflow "RR Jitter Backoff Canary" created by Romi H. (ID: 51802)
Asha P.: Runbook checklist: mute expected alerts, publish dashboard link, ensure webhook retry idempotency, notify SDR rotation. We'll review metrics at T+20m.
Connor W.: If enrichment pipeline backlog > 300, autoscaler signal will shorten delay to 10s automatically. We'll wire that into the feature flag.
Romi H.: Rolling in 10m. I'll ping @here at T-2. Keep thread short during the canary so alerts stand out. :rocket:
